description: In repos/activity-api/src/routes/execution-traces.ts, the GET '/selection-outcomes' route returns HTTP 500 on every single call and has never once served a response. Its `selectionsQuery` reads `FROM thompson_selection_log AS sel`, and SurrealDB does not support table aliases, so the statement fails to parse with "Unexpected token `AS`, expected Eof". The alias is also referenced in the WHERE conditions built above it as `sel.activity_id`, `sel.selected_at`, and in the `ORDER BY sel.selected_at DESC`. Remove the table alias from this one route: change the FROM clause to `FROM thompson_selection_log`, drop the `sel.` prefix from the three condition strings that build `selectionConditions`, and change the ORDER BY to `ORDER BY selected_at DESC`. The bare column names are correct because there is only one table in the statement. Do not restructure the handler otherwise — the two-fetch pattern it already uses (read selections, then read the execution table by correlation_id, then join in memory) is the same JOIN-free shape that commit 471febb established for the sibling route GET '/selection-calibration', which works today. Verify by curling the route and getting HTTP 200 instead of HTTP 500; an empty result array is the expected and correct outcome, because this route reads the legacy recommend-driven selection path that migration 202 superseded with universal per-execution capture.
